tracks.title: 五台車一个聲 Gōo Tâi Tshia Tsi̍t Ê Siann
tracks.subject: The auntie who records sound-truck slogans behind a Huwei stationery shop voices all five rival council candidates (numbers only, no real parties), so in the final week her own voice out-shouts itself at the roundabout, and she still won't tell her husband her vote.
